messages:
Renee: quick ping  the internal KB link from onboarding -> 'service-keys' is returning 404 in prod. saw it in a support ticket.
Omar: thanks, do you have the exact href?
Renee: it points to /kb/security/service-keys but the page got moved to /kb/security/keys-management last month during the restructure.
edit-bot: link-scan: detected stale internal link /kb/security/service-keys in onboarding (prod). logged ticket KB-2468.
Kai: ok easy win: update the onboarding page nav or add a redirect. I can take the redirect in content/_redirects.yaml.
Renee: there are ~3 places linking the old path (onboarding, support-playbook, and partner-integration). might be worth a small grep and patch PR to update all references.
Omar: @Kai if you do the redirect, @Renee can open a single PR that updates the three files. tag me and @Theo for review.
Renee: opened PR: https://git.internal.redwood.io/docs/pr/9123  changes: add redirect rule, update three links, and add a one-line frontmatter changelog on each edited doc. local commands I ran:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/kb-servicekeys-redirect
rg "/kb/security/service-keys" -n || true
sed -i 's|/kb/security/service-keys|/kb/security/keys-management|g' content/onboarding/*.md content/support-playbook/*.md content/partners/*.md
echo "/kb/security/service-keys /kb/security/keys-management 301" >> content/_redirects.yaml
git commit -am "docs(kb): update stale service-keys links + add redirect"
git push origin fix/kb-servicekeys-redirect
```
Kai: nice. small ask: include a preview assertion that follows redirects so staging smoke catches regressions.
Renee: added a tiny Cypress check that hits the old path and asserts it lands on keys-management. also added "changelog: fix broken kb links" to frontmatter on updated docs.
Theo: quick review  LGTM. tiny nit: combine the redirect append and commit into one atomic commit to avoid a transient preview state.
Renee: squashed the redirect and link edits into one commit and updated PR description. bumped for merge.
edit-bot: PR 9123 passed CI and was merged by Theo. KB-2468 closed.
Omar: verified prod bounce  old links now 301 -> keys-management. thanks all for the quick patch.
Renee: closing out the support ticket. extra: logging this as a small postmortem in KB-2468 describing how we missed the link during the restructure and adding a small pre-merge grep check to the docs checklist.
Kai: love that. will add a lint step in docs CI next sprint to flag old /kb/security/service-keys references to catch earlier. :thumbsup:
